_comment: Named figure sets: one entry = one comparison = one directory results/<experiment>/sweep/<NAME>/
with fixed file names, so results stay stable across re-runs instead of accumulating ad-hoc PNGs.
(scripts/06_plot_comparison.py --set NAME). `arms` is also the legend order. `baseline` is the
arm the ratio and paired figures divide by: the production engine on that set's card, or the
reference configuration of the comparison. Register a set here rather than passing --arms by
hand; a set is the reproducible unit, and its manifest.json records what it was read from.
Every arm in a set needs an entry in configs/arm_style.json with a hue no other arm in the set uses.
